name: readiness_insufficient_data
why: Degenerate case: fewer than 2 signals logged today produces an explicit insufficient-data state, never a fabricated score.

must_include.reason: home screen prompts the user to log instead of showing a score — prototype copy: 'No score yet — log a couple of signals and Nora will score your readiness.' with a 'Log now' action
the readiness arc still renders, reading '--' under the 'Readiness' label, so the surface never looks broken
